svg.title: Self-storage versus an extra bedroom in Toronto and Calgary
svg.desc: Toronto extra-bedroom gap using TRREB Q2 2026 one-bed $2,273 versus StatCan QRS two-bed asking $2,650 is $377. A labelled climate-controlled 5x10 is $220. Calgary two-bed asking $1,890 versus a labelled $1,550 one-bed is $340 versus $160 storage.
svg.text: Storage vs a bigger lease: the month you never exit
Toronto: TRREB 1-bed $2,273 vs StatCan QRS Q2 2026 2-bed ask $2,650. Calgary 2-bed ask $1,890 (Daily, 9 Sep 2026).
*Storage bars are labelled 2026 operator bands (climate-controlled 5x10), not a quote. Add lock, admin, and tenant-insurance riders.
24 months of $220 storage is $5,280 — often more than selling the sofa and paying one local move ($450-$900 studio/1-bed band).
Calgary 1-bed is a labelled $1,550 listing sketch so the $340 gap is honest about mix. Declutter first. Not a storage brokerage.
